preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access owner-only functions

exploit_hint: As contract owner, call claimTokens() function to drain all BNB from contract balance to owner's wallet. Alternatively, set marketingWallet or liquidityCollector to attacker's address using setmarketingWallet() or setLiquidityCollector(), then trigger swapAndMarketing() through token transfers to accumulate contract tokens and swap them for BNB sent to attacker's wallet.
